caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl shown from a top-down perspective and a side profile directly underneath. The main view shows the inside of the bowl, which has a yellowish-brown base color with variations in tone and some greenish patches. In the center of the bowl, there is an illustration of an animal resembling a goat or deer, colored reddish-brown with slightly darker outlines and two curved horns. The animal is depicted standing on a textured patch that suggests ground or grass, represented with vertical brownish lines. The interior surface of the bowl is decorated with large green and white leaves, branching outward from the center. There is also a large flower with a yellow center and white petals visible in the upper right section of the bowl. The composition includes small scattered marks and discolorations throughout the surface, indicative of texture or age. The side profile below shows the bowl as shallow and gently curving, with a consistent brown coloration. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige.
title: Pa. German Plate
